fullContent:
Palandava Ghritam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Introduction 
 Palandava Ghritam is a classical formulation that is available as in the form of herbal ghee. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Jeerak 
 Patha 
 Grita 
 Palandu Swarasa (Onion juice) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients are added to ghee and cooked as ghrit paak method. 
 Dose 
 Have 1/4-1/2 tsp followed by hot water on empty stomach 1-2 times or as recommended by the physician. It can be taken early morning on empty stomach or at noon after meals. 
 Dosage up to 15 to 25 ml is also recommended. 
 Indications 
 
 Piles 
 Fistula 
 Skin diseases 
 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This Ayurvedic formulation is an effective treatment for piles and fistula. 
 Also useful herbal remedy for skin diseases, ulcers etc. 
 
 Contraindications/Side Effects 
 Use it under Medical Directions. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
